messages.content: I’ll commit a book that charges in the cheapest hours, sells into the morning and evening peaks, and earns reserve revenue while retaining room for regulation drift. I’ll then manage the book through the remaining watches.

The battery is at 125 MWh, and there have been no reserve failures so far. Morning RegDn delivered no charging energy, so I’m reducing the final sale and sizing the last recharge to meet the 125 MWh end target even if evening RegDn also delivers none.
